Civic budget explainer

Who Gets Public Money?

A government budget explainer showing how taxes become public spending as healthcare, education, pensions, defense, and local services compete.

Ready 00:00 / 00:20

Taxes create a shared public budget.

Limited resources plus legitimate claims create political conflict.

Institutions turn that conflict into a compromise stable enough to hold.

This 20-second animation shows public revenue flowing into a limited budget, social groups making competing claims on that budget, democratic institutions processing the conflict, and a temporary compromise emerging where no group gets everything but shared priorities are funded.
